toolchain: OpenCV's Docker build (opencv_3rdparty ffmpeg/build_via_docker.sh): Ubuntu mingw-w64 cross toolchain x86_64-w64-mingw32 (static libgcc/libstdc++)

configuration.static_with: libvpx, libaom (BSD) and the OpenH264 API headers; OpenCV videoio FFmpeg plugin (Apache-2.0) from the OpenCV commit retained

build_commands: tar xzf opencv_3rdparty-d82ad9a5-ffmpeg-4.x_20251226.tar.gz; place ffmpeg-4.4.6 (from the retained tarball, tag n4.4.6) at build/ffmpeg and OpenCV cff7581175d2 at opencv/
fetch libvpx / aom / openh264 at the tags download_src.sh names (BSD; not LGPL)
ffmpeg/build_via_docker.sh  (runs make_mingw.sh: configure as above, make, then build_videoio_plugin.sh links opencv_videoio_ffmpeg_64.dll)
correspondence: The shipped opencv_videoio_ffmpeg4130_64.dll is byte-identical to the opencv_python_headless-4.13.0.92-cp37-abi3-win_amd64.whl member; its strings name OpenCV 'cff7581…' version 4.13.0-pre (equal to the retained OpenCV snapshot's version.hpp) and FFmpeg libavcodec 58.134; opencv_3rdparty d82ad9a5's download_src.sh pins FFmpeg n4.4.6.
